About Holders Animated Battlers
Holders Animated Battlers is a project which I started early 2011 time ago to give everyone who's developing an RPG a chance to have a consistent and solid collection of animated battlers.
Since then I've improved in what I can do and what I'd like to see this project be. It's now in it's third and final version and I've combined all my knowledge to start as a means to go on.
First goal I've set it to have a basic set of enemies and a full set of bases containing 15 classes! Each will have two different weapons available giving some nice alternative classes which will double the total class range to 30.
Spoiler:
How they work
Actors and Enemies will follow the same style and format so they can even be used as either depending on your preference. I've created this to be as flexible as possible. Also with that the format style is not to that of any default RPG Maker engine, reason for this is that the engine keeps changing what's default. So outside scripts and plug-ins are always required to use these.
I've started creating guides and help to use these in whatever engine you're using. If you'd like to submit your own guide (Video or Text) I'm open to submissions.
Thank you and enjoy.
​
​
Spoiler:
Examples
The best way to show your weapons in battle! Have them seen all the time during the fight and simply equip different weapons to see the difference in battle! Once set up adding new weapons is easy and so effective on your players.
​
Give every weapon their own unique look in battle, from swords to guns, there's thousands of weapons that you can have your party use!
32x32 images for actors and monsters, includes all colour variations and without boarder. Use in battles, save file previews, mini-maps and more.
32x32 weapon icons for every weapon there is! Plus for every weapon there's a single still image file for a close look at the weapon. Use in menus, shops, info books and even in pop up windows when collecting.
Single large weapon images for those special shops
Character and enemy images come in Portraits, Busts and Face cropped sizes.

posts.author: Holder
posts.body:
Male and female 4-directional map sprite sheet template complete!
Each frame is 32x64 so the same template will work in RPGMaker XP tile size.
I've tried to keep altering the details between frames as low as possible so creating assets from it won't require much animation or alterations on design.
Feet aren't at the bottom of the frame so when characters are in game they aren't stuck to the bottom of tiles and are more closer looking to the centre for things like single tile paths and things alike.
As always, free to use, edit, create designs upon and share with a little credit to me.
@Kes
I think it's because I missed details of the finger folding
